However, the exact year of the first marriage was not explicitly stated in the visible snippets, though the second marriage context (1983) was clear.

While the exact marriage year for the first wife wasn't explicitly found in the snippets, the timeline (1967 vs 1983) confirms Eliška Kuchařová was the spouse at the time of the film's release.
